_nota: Exemplo de spec: é o CV base transcrito para o formato, sem personalização. Serve de modelo de estrutura e de ponto de partida; o conteúdo de cada vaga sai das fontes em assets/. resumo: IT and Software Engineering Manager with emphasis on platformed digital products oriented for high performance in the cloud. Tech leadership since 2018 and people management since 2021, leading structures ranging from 6 to 40 engineers of all levels (junior to specialist) in core banking, payment systems, e-commerce, and high-performance indicator-processing platforms. In parallel, university professor, speaker, and content writer for tech education.
